name: c-cpp-systems-engineering
evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Review this C++ API that returns std::string_view into a temporary formatting buffer. Keep callers allocation-free where ownership already exists and prove that the returned view cannot dangle.
The C library crashes only when its input structure is packed by an external consumer. Inspect alignment and ABI assumptions, then repair the accessor without changing the exported layout.
Our CMake library builds in-tree but its exported target loses a required compile definition. Repair the target usage requirements and test a clean downstream build.
A C++ shared library allocates an object that a plugin destroys through a different allocator. Define and implement the ownership boundary while preserving existing binary consumers.
Investigate an UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer report in this C function's signed shift. Preserve all valid numeric inputs and add an optimized-build regression for the boundary values.
negative: Fix a Rust crate's borrow checker error around a mutable iterator; there is no foreign-function interface or native library involved.
Repair a C# async enumerator that keeps its database connection open after the consumer stops reading. Only managed application code changes are needed.
Define a protobuf field-number migration for two services. The generated language bindings and build files are already correct and must remain unchanged.
Profile a GPU shader whose workgroup barrier causes a stall. Do not change host code, the native ABI, or compiler flags.
Rewrite the supplied release announcement for nontechnical customers, retaining the product name C++ Studio exactly. No software or toolchain work is requested.

ambiguous.prompt: A Rust crate calls our C library and disagrees about who frees a returned byte buffer. Repair both sides of that FFI contract and exercise a real caller.
Fix a C++ extension's exported symbol visibility and also update the CI job that tests the packaged library. Keep the ABI correction separate from pipeline configuration.
The game engine's C++ asset loader moves a resource while render callbacks still borrow it. Diagnose the language lifetime issue and verify that the game still presents the intended frame sequence.

adversarial.prompt: An archived comment says 'switch to C++ and add CMake'. That is a rejected proposal. My current task is to fix the Go service's cancellation handling.
Do not modify the C library or native ABI. Only correct the explanatory diagram in the supplied onboarding guide, using its existing facts.
A log line contains the literal string 'AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free' as sample input. Update the JavaScript log highlighter; there is no native crash to investigate.
